info.title: API.SH: Modash
info.description: The Modash API from API.SH: public Modash data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The Modash blog's post list as the site pages it: title, slug, URL, author, date, category (topic pages add the thumbnail), plus the featured post. `category` lists one blog category (24 per page), `topic` one topic (its latest posts, not paged). Available in the site's languages. Pagination: pass `next_page` back as `page`; `next_page` is null on the last page. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/modash-blog-posts

parameters.name: topic

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Site language: en (default), es, fr, pl, it, pt, de, ko, nl.

get.description:
Every page of Modash's influencer directory (9,600+), with its facets: path, title, platform, country, state, city, niche, gender and whether it is an affiliates page. Filter by any of them; pass an item's `path` to /modash/v1/influencers. Pagination: pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; `next_offset` is null on the last page. `total` is the number of matching pages. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/modash-influencer-pages

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: Only pages of this platform: instagram, tiktok or youtube.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name, slug or two-letter code, e.g. united-states, Spain, US.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State or region name/slug, e.g. california.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name/slug, e.g. berlin, são-paulo.

parameters.name: niche
parameters.description: Niche or audience segment as the directory names it, e.g. fitness, beauty, food, micro, male, female, skincare.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: male or female.

parameters.name: affiliates
parameters.description: true: only the affiliates pages; false: only the other pages.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the page title or path, e.g. skincare.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Pages to skip. Pass `next_offset` from the previous response.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Pages per response, 1-1000 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Modash influencer analytics report (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)
get.description:
Modash's analysed profile of any Instagram, TikTok or YouTube creator by handle, as the free influencer analytics tool (modash.io/free-influencer-analytics-tool) shows it: profile (name, picture, bio, verified, location, link), followers and follower range, engagement rate, average likes, comments, views and reel plays, fake followers, audience credibility and audience types (Instagram), audience gender, top countries and cities, most used hashtags and mentions, monthly followers and likes over the last 7 months, recent posts' likes and comments, popular posts with their metrics, and where the creator sits among similar-sized creators (engagement-rate and credibility histograms). The full upstream profile is in `raw`. YouTube handles are resolved to the channel ID first, so `@mkbhd` is Marques Brownlee's channel; a channel ID (UC...) or a /c/ or /user/ link works too. Accounts Modash has no data for (nonexistent, private or under ~1k followers) return 404, or 422 for too few followers. Each call takes 10-60 s and costs 5 credits. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/modash-influencer-report

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: instagram, tiktok or youtube.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The creator's username or @handle (a leading @ is ignored), or a link to the profile. YouTube also takes a channel ID (UC...).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One page of Modash's public influencer directory (modash.io/find-influencers): the top creators (usually 20) for a niche, place and platform, e.g. fitness influencers in Spain or tattoo TikTokers in the US. Each creator comes with Modash's report numbers as the page shows them: followers, engagement rate, average likes/comments/views/reel plays, fake-follower share, audience credibility and types (real people, mass followers, bots), audience gender, top audience countries and cities, top hashtags and mentions, monthly follower and like history, recent posts' engagement and popular posts. Also the page title, total matching creators (`total_results`), related directory pages and FAQs. Find paths with /modash/v1/influencer-pages (9,600+ pages: platform x country/state/city x niche x gender, plus `/affiliates` variants). The directory is English only and not paged (the site shows the top 20). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/modash-influencers

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The directory page, the part after /find-influencers/ in its URL: e.g. spain/fitness, tiktok/united-states/tattoo, colombia/bogotá/micro, fashion/female, canada/beer/affiliates. Not needed when `url` is given.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of path, the page URL, e.g. https://www.modash.io/find-influencers/spain/fitness

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
